svg.title: Payroll support, employee pay, and remittances
svg.desc: Payroll support, employee pay, and remittances. Which obligation is employee-specific, and which is period-level? Primary tables: PayrollPeriod, LaborTimeEntry, PayrollRegister, PayrollRegisterLine, PayrollPayment, PayrollLiabilityRemittance. PayrollSummary is a constructed GLEntry source label, not a table. Aggregate registers by period, cost center, and account to reconcile recognition; remittances have a different grain from employee payments.
